messages.subject: [D-RUG]: Work group/"aggiedown" presentation tomorrow 12-2pm
parts:
Hi All,

Tomorrow we will be having our weekly work group from 12-2pm in 360 Shields Library. For the first part of the work group, Ryan Peek will be presenting on his R package "aggiedown" which is an awesome package for writing your Dissertation at UC Davis (and beyond) using RStudio.

"Writing your dissertation is hard...formatting it is even harder. If you are interested in using a bookdown/Rmarkdown template that has been formatted for UC Davis specifications to generate a clean and correctly typeset pdf of your work, please come ask questions or help me break this package so I can make it better."

If you are planning on attending Ryan's talk, please install aggiedown before the work group by following the instructions on the README.md on the aggiedown github page: https://github.com/ryanpeek/aggiedown

Hope to see you there!
Martha 

--
Martha Wohlfeil

Graduate Group in Ecology
Avian Ecology Lab, PhD Candidate
Wickson Hall 3017
University of California, Davis 
marthawohlfeil.github.io
